item.title: Humanoid robots start sorting luggage in Tokyo airport test amid labor shortage
item.description: Humanoid robots could load cargo and clean aircraft cabins at Haneda Airport.

item.title: GitHub will start charging Copilot users based on their actual AI usage

item.title: The great American data center divide
item.description: Many rural communities are viscerally opposed to AI infrastructure.

item.description: Musk’s shifting stance on AI dangers may complicate trial over OpenAI’s mission.

item.title: OpenAI ends its exclusive partnership with Microsoft
